history.name: Text copies out as the words it is
history.description: Prose selected out of the finished document pastes back as the sentences it was — a client can quote a feature description into an email, and the document is searchable and readable by assistive software. This is the reason the edition is set in the specific font files it is: the convenient alternative produces a file that looks right and whose text comes back shredded when anyone copies it.
history.dev_notes: Static font instances embed as CID TrueType with Identity-H; a variable instance exports through Chromium as a Type 3 font whose glyphs are drawing procedures. Six decorative tracked-caps labels on the cover are the deliberate exception; every line of content copies verbatim.
